\caption{The primary comparison under the robustness runs of amendment 9 (exploratory; corrected code; the primary row uses the frozen subsampling seed 20261025). Cells: evaluated cells; baseline gain: $\mathrm{BS}(\mathrm{M0})-\mathrm{BS}(\mathrm{M1})$ in units of $10^{-3}$; odds ratio: flooding within 500\,m of water-side names relative to other names, given the held-out terrain prediction of the run, with a pairs cluster bootstrap 95\,\% interval (2,000 replicates); not computed for the seeds. Permanent water: cells whose mean JRC GSW occurrence at 25 points is at least 50\,\% were removed in every AOI (32{,}914 cells, 2.2\,\%, in 271 AOIs; 14{,}527 in AOIs with a hydrography layer and 18{,}387 in AOIs without one), in addition to the water of each product's hydrography layer. Seeds: the seed that draws cells within location groups under the cap (frozen: 20261025). Bare-earth elevation: the elevation features rebuilt from FABDEM v1-2 (Hawker et al., 2022), and HAND replaced by the heights of each cell above the nearest vertex of a HydroRIVERS river draining at least 100 and 1000\,km$^2$; the location model M0 is unchanged. Its baseline model flagged the observed number of flooded cells per AOI with a median critical success index of 0.12 (with GLO-30 and HAND: 0.13); with the names, the median difference was 0.000. By the rule fixed in amendment 9, these runs do not replace the confirmatory verdict, and an odds ratio whose interval excludes one would remain an uncorroborated description.}\label{tab:nine-runs}
